title: Regular Expression Matching
description: Given an input string `s` and a pattern `p`, implement regular expression matching with support for '.' and '*' where '.' matches any single character and '*' matches zero or more of the preceding element.
input_format: Two lines: first string `s`, second pattern `p`.

sample_tests.explanation: a does not match entire string aa.
* matches zero or more of the preceding 'a'.

hints: Define DP state `dp(i, j)`: does s[i:] match p[j:]?
If p[j+1] == '*', we can either skip the '*' (match 0 times) or match s[i] and continue.
Otherwise, s[i] must match p[j] (or '.') and recurse on dp(i+1, j+1).
